Messages

Your home can’t be reached

You may see this while using Maktaba.

What this means

The computer that runs Maktaba didn’t answer. It may be turned off, restarting after an update, or not connected to the network. Your library is safe: nothing is lost while it’s away.

What you can do

  1. Check that the computer is on and connected to the network.
  2. If it’s updating, wait a minute. Maktaba tries again by itself every few seconds.
  3. Open the app again on the screen you’re using.

Who can help

If it still doesn’t answer, ask the person who runs your home. If that’s you, Troubleshooting goes through it step by step.
